scope: Checks every parsed graph for root accessibility, exact table/key agreement, consecutive zero-based ordinals, strict key order, and canonicality under all root-fixing vertex permutations with independent port swaps. Every upper witness is independently simulated over every original static mask. Complete coverage requires the known Burnside count, regardless of --expected-count.
lower_bound_warning: Input lower bounds greater than 1 and claimed exact minimal lengths are inherited claims, not independently proved by this verifier. No shortest-length proof or complete tie certificate is claimed.
upper_frontier_note: The distribution and frontier keys describe independently verified witness upper bounds. Identifying actual maximizers additionally requires independently checked matching lower proofs for every frontier graph.
